newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in morning, inspired by Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in morning, inspired by Dow rise.

text.p: The Tokyo Nikkei average jumped at the start of the Wednesday morning session, poking past the psychologically important 18,000 line.
Brokers said stocks were inspired by a surge in Dow industrials as well as in Chicago Nikkei futures overnight.
As of 0012 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 125.32 points, or 0.70 percent, at 18,058.91. Its June futures had added 90 points to 18,050.
"Pressure to dissolve cross-shareholdings is strong between 18,000 and 18,500, so the gains could be short-lived," said Hideo Yoshimura of Izumi Securities.
